deck_name: Bandwidth Brawl: 30 Cards of Internet Chaos
description:
Complete rules for play: This is a 2-player dueling card game deck. Each player uses an identical copy of this 30-card deck. Each player starts at 25 Avatar HP. Shuffle your deck and draw 5 cards. You may mulligan once by shuffling any number of cards from your hand into your deck, then drawing that many.

Turn structure: (1) Start of turn: gain +1 max Ping (resource), up to 10, then refill Ping to max. (2) Draw 1 card. (3) Main phase: play any number of cards by paying Ping costs. Unit cards enter the board. Action cards resolve immediately, then go to discard. (4) Combat: each ready friendly Unit may attack once, targeting either an enemy Unit or the enemy Avatar. (5) End turn.

Board and combat rules: Maximum 5 Units per side. Units have Attack and Health. Damage stays on Units until healed. If a Unit's Health is 0 or less, it is destroyed. Units cannot attack on the turn they are played unless they have Rush.

Keywords: Firewall = enemy Units must attack a friendly Firewall Unit before they can attack other friendly Units or the Avatar. Rush = can attack enemy Units on the turn it is played. Sneaky = cannot be targeted by enemy Action cards until it deals combat damage for the first time. Stun = a stunned Unit cannot attack on its controller's next turn.

Deck identity and balance notes: This singleton deck has 30 unique cards with a balanced curve (6 one-cost, 7 two-cost, 7 three-cost, 5 four-cost, 3 five-cost, 2 six-cost). It includes tempo, draw, healing, single-target removal, and board control so games have multiple viable lines and no single auto-win combo.

cards.name: 404 Scout
cards.text: On Play: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Never found, always somehow first to report in.

cards.name: Cookie Click Intern
cards.text: On Play: Gain 1 Ping this turn only.
cards.flavor: Legally not a tracker, spiritually very much a tracker.

cards.name: Captcha Goblin
cards.text: On Play: Enemy Avatar takes 1 damage unless that player discards a card.
cards.flavor: Select all images with bicycles. There are no bicycles.

cards.name: Cache Squirrel
cards.text: Firewall.
cards.flavor: It hoards acorns and last year's JavaScript.

cards.name: Typo Ninja
cards.text: Sneaky. Whenever this deals combat damage, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: Now introducing the all-new pubic beta.

cards.name: Status Page Optimist
cards.text: Restore 2 Health to any target. Draw a card if that target is at full Health afterward.
cards.flavor: All systems operational (except the system that checks systems).

cards.name: Ad Block Barbarian
cards.text: On Play: Remove all temporary Attack buffs from a Unit.
cards.flavor: If it moves, he installs an extension on it.

cards.name: Midnight Moderator
cards.text: Firewall. On Play: Stun an enemy Unit with cost 2 or less.
cards.flavor: Bonk. Next case.

cards.name: Emoji Necromancer
cards.text: Whenever this survives damage, draw a card.
cards.flavor: He speaks only in skulls and sparkles.

cards.name: Lag Wizard
cards.text: Rush.
cards.flavor: You are already defeated. Your connection just has not shown it yet.

cards.name: Terms and Conditions
cards.text: Stun a Unit. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: By continuing, you agree to continue forever.

cards.name: Screenshot Evidence
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to any target.
cards.flavor: Enhance. Enhance. Enhance. Yup, that is definitely embarrassing.

cards.name: Reboot Ritual
cards.text: Draw 2 cards, then your Avatar takes 1 damage.
cards.flavor: Have you tried turning your strategy off and on again?

cards.name: Patch Tuesday Paladin
cards.text: On Play: Restore 3 Health to your Avatar or a friendly Unit.
cards.flavor: Ships fixes at dawn, new bugs by lunch.

cards.name: Doomscroll Diver
cards.text: At end of your turn, if this did not attack, it takes 1 damage.
cards.flavor: Just one more post.

cards.name: VPN Vagabond
cards.text: Sneaky.
cards.flavor: Today he logs in from three countries and one toaster.

cards.name: Keyboard Warrior
cards.text: Rush. Whenever this destroys a Unit, gain +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Caps Lock is not a key, it is a lifestyle.

cards.name: Cloud Hoarder
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. You cannot play more than 1 additional card this turn.
cards.flavor: Unlimited storage, limited self-control.

cards.name: Hotfix Hero
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a Unit. If it is destroyed, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Fast, brave, and tested in production.

cards.name: Group Chat Stampede
cards.text: Your Units gain +1 Attack this turn. Draw a card if you control 3 or more Units.
cards.flavor: Muting was never an option.

cards.name: Influencer Bard
cards.text: On Play: Each player draws a card.
cards.flavor: Do not forget to like, subscribe, and fear my sponsored combo.

cards.name: Firewall Dragon
cards.text: Firewall.
cards.flavor: Breathes encrypted flames and legal disclaimers.

cards.name: Bug Report Genie
cards.text: On Play: Return another friendly Unit to your hand. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Wish granted: issue reproduced instantly.

cards.name: Ctrl+Alt+Defeat
cards.text: Destroy a damaged Unit.
cards.flavor: Task failed successfully.

cards.name: Comment Section Cleanup
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all Units.
cards.flavor: Some threads cannot be saved, only archived.

cards.name: Algorithm Overlord
cards.text: At end of your turn, if you played 2 or more cards this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: It knows what you want before you do, and it is wrong.

cards.name: Meme Mech Titan
cards.text: Rush.
cards.flavor: Powered by reposts and unresolved irony.

cards.name: Customer Support Phoenix
cards.text: When this is destroyed, restore 5 Health to your Avatar.
cards.flavor: Your ticket is very important to us and also immortal.

cards.name: Patch Notes Final Boss
cards.text: On Play: Deal 2 damage to all enemy Units.
cards.flavor: Nerfed, buffed, reworked, still terrifying.

cards.name: Internet Outage
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to all Units. Then each Avatar restores 4 Health.
cards.flavor: Everyone logs off and suddenly remembers birds exist.
